entry.title: Portoryko racjonuje wodę dla 500 tys. osób z powodu najgorszej suszy od 2015

entry.title: Major wildfire in hills above Lake Garda: at least 200 residents and tourists evacuated
entry.content: A fire broke out on Friday evening in the mountains above Tignale. Rescuers evacuated about 200 people and are checking holiday homes used by tourists.

entry.content: On Saturday, the Tisza Party, which has a constitutional majority in Parliament, picked András Baka who was removed by Fidesz from the Supreme Court, to be elected president on Tuesday.

entry.title: Porto Santo travel guide: Escape to one of Europe’s most underrated islands
entry.content: Just a short ferry ride from Madeira, Porto Santo has long lived in its bigger neighbour’s shadow. But, with nine kilometres of golden sand, otherworldly dunes and a laidback pace of life, this tiny Portuguese island might just be Europe’s next big holiday hotspot.

entry.title: US appeals court orders halt to Trump ballroom construction without congressional approval
entry.content: The US Court of Appeals for the DC Circuit, which had allowed construction to continue while it considered the case, agreed with a lower court that such a massive White House overhaul required the explicit consent of Congress.

entry.title: US Senate approves sweeping Russia sanctions bill targeting energy income
entry.content: The package would impose sanctions on Russian officials, oligarchs, financial institutions and the so-called shadow fleet used to evade restrictions on Moscow's oil exports. It would also allow President Donald Trump to set tariffs of up to 500% on Russian imports, including gas and oil.
